title: Zero-dependency MCP server implemented on the stdlib

title: Very dense one-liner style lowers maintainability
evidence: maintainability=0.544 (scores.json); e.g. brazilian_soccer_mcp/queries.py:32-37 nested comprehension in fmt_match and queries.py:150-175 the fixture-merge loop pack substantial logic into few lines

title: FIFA dataset omits several major Brazilian clubs; handled gracefully

suggestion: No action — a data limitation the code surfaces honestly to the caller, not a defect
